resources.string: Record location while other apps are on the car screen
On. Trip distance, time, average speed and the parking spot stay accurate even while Maps or another app is on the car screen.
Off. Opening the dashboard keeps location recording when other apps cover it. Turn on to record from car connection, before opening the dashboard.
Choose “Allow all the time” to record from car connection, before opening the dashboard. Recording started from the dashboard already continues when other apps cover it.

Opening the dashboard keeps location recording when other apps cover it. This option lets FermataX collect location in the background during Android Auto sessions from car connection, before the dashboard opens, for trip statistics and the parking spot. FermataX sends no location to its own servers. You can turn this off in Settings.\n\nOn the next screen choose “Allow all the time”.
Location permission “Allow all the time” was not granted
Turn on trip recording in Settings on the phone
Allow location “All the time” on the phone to record trips
